scope: Additive reviewed sources; live audit remains in progress.

games.title: Call of Duty: World at War

resources.name: Aspirin Azza
resources.compatibility: The aspirin_pc branch contains seven maps/mp/gametypes GSC scripts. dom.gsc sets MenuOpen but ADS/Attack scrolling checks OpenMenu; no OpenMenu assignment was found across those seven files. Exact PC client/update and install workflow are undocumented.
resources.description: Aspirin Azza PC raw-script branch with a separate PS3 fastfile. A static menu-state discrepancy remains unresolved.

guideBlocks.title: Keep the PC script tree intact
guideBlocks.text: Preserve aspirin_pc/maps/mp/gametypes with all seven GSC files. The separate patch_mp.ff PS3 member belongs to the console branch. READ ME.txt gives credits/features without a PC installation destination or loading/build workflow.

guideBlocks.title: Controls visible in dom.gsc
items: The opening prompt/check uses Smoke or secondary-offhand together with Frag.
Use selects and Melee backs out.
ADS/Attack are intended for scrolling, but their state guards differ from the initialized/opened field. These are engine actions, not fixed keyboard mappings.

guideBlocks.title: Unresolved source discrepancy
guideBlocks.text: dom.gsc assigns MenuOpen during initialization/open/close but its ADS/Attack scrolling guards test OpenMenu. No OpenMenu assignment appears in its seven PC scripts. This is a static concern rather than a runtime diagnosis; the source is unchanged. No update or map pin is supplied.

resources.name: CabePex V1.5
resources.compatibility: Publisher listings identify PC/PS3/Xbox V1.5 and an unfinished update. The exact captured publisher thread returned HTTP403. No PC archive, controls, game-update or map requirements were verified.
resources.description: CabePex V1.5 publisher reference. Public publisher listings say the project is unfinished; no accessible PC asset or exact setup guide was verified.

guideBlocks.title: Publisher source and access result
guideBlocks.text: The Discord post links the CabePex V1.5 publisher thread. Public browsing returned HTTP403 for that thread; its indexed publisher listing names PC/PS3/Xbox and says the update remains unfinished. No authentication, payment or access bypass was attempted.

guideBlocks.title: No verified PC asset/setup
guideBlocks.text: No matching PC archive or accessible installation workflow was established from this source. A console-labelled CabePex archive from another URL is not substituted for the publisher's PC version. V1.5 is the source label; controls, update and map pins remain unspecified.

resources.name: IVI40A3Fusionz
resources.compatibility: Archive separates PC and PS3. The PC tree supplies IVI40A3Fusionz.gsc, File1.gsc–File14.gsc and maps/mp/gametypes/_rank.gsc. It gives action-based controls but no README/install workflow, exact PC client/update or map pins.

guideBlocks.title: Preserve the complete PC branch
guideBlocks.text: Keep the whole PC/IVI40A3Fusionz 'Unreleased Patch' directory with its main script, File1–File14 helpers and maps/mp/gametypes/_rank.gsc. The separate PS3/patch_mp.ff is a console component. No PC installation path or loader/build workflow is supplied; a raw tree is not described as a compiled PC fastfile.

guideBlocks.title: Actions displayed by the PC script
items: Frag opens the mod menu; Smoke/secondary-offhand opens the player menu where available.
Attack/ADS navigate, Use or activate selects and Melee backs out.
Actions follow the player's bindings; no fixed keyboard keys or tested behavior are inferred.

guideBlocks.title: Version limit
guideBlocks.text: The archive says Unreleased Patch UPDATED without a numeric release. Exact PC client/update and supported maps are undocumented; verify the loading workflow before installation.

resources.name: Money 'n' Weed v1
resources.compatibility: Scripts explicitly branch for nazi_zombie_prototype, nazi_zombie_asylum, nazi_zombie_sumpf and nazi_zombie_factory and call Zombies functions. These are source map references, not tested support. Raw scripts/assets lack a documented PC loader/build workflow or update pin.
resources.description: Money 'n' Weed v1 · source-listed PC resource.

guideBlocks.title: Keep all runtime components together
guideBlocks.text: Preserve the root's maps, QM_Dino and weapons/sp trees plus missingasset.csv. The archive supplies GSC and weapon assets without a compiled fastfile or setup guide. Both New Text Document markers are empty; no install destination, supported PC client or build/loading workflow is documented.

guideBlocks.title: Actions in maps/_createdynents.gsc
items: ADS plus Melee opens the menu.
Attack/ADS scroll, Use selects and Melee backs out.
These are engine actions rather than fixed keyboard bindings.

guideBlocks.title: Exact map evidence
guideBlocks.text: The code branches for nazi_zombie_prototype, nazi_zombie_asylum, nazi_zombie_sumpf and nazi_zombie_factory. This establishes Zombies-oriented code paths, not a compatibility test or all-map promise. No update or internal release beyond the post's v1 label is supplied.

resources.name: Physics 'n' Flex v2
resources.compatibility: Source-listed PC common.ff has IWffu100 magic and little-endian header value 387. That is container evidence, not a game-update/TU or internal menu-version pin. No mode, maps, PC client or setup instructions are documented.
resources.description: Physics 'n' Flex v2 · source-listed PC resource.

guideBlocks.title: Standalone FastFile evidence
guideBlocks.text: The exact source supplies common.ff only. Static header inspection identifies IWffu100 and header value 387, which are not substituted for game-update or menu versions. The post supplies the v2 label.

guideBlocks.title: Setup remains undocumented
guideBlocks.text: No destination, replacement procedure, required PC client, mode, map, game update or opening control is supplied. Preserve original game files and verify these requirements before replacing data. No console title update/path is transferred from similarly named menus.

resources.name: xKoVx V3
resources.compatibility: default_mp.xex has XEX2 magic. README uses XEXMenu and LT plus Knife after spawning. No PC executable, script branch or PC loader/setup workflow, update or map pins are supplied.
resources.description: PC source/platform mismatch: xKoVx V3 supplies an Xbox 360 executable/patch with XEXMenu instructions; no PC build is supplied.

guideBlocks.title: Xbox files retained as reference
guideBlocks.text: The archive contains patch_mp.ff, default_mp.xex and READ MEH!.txt. The executable begins with XEX2 and README uses XEXMenu, so the exact file is not a verified PC build. Preserve the archive without transplanting its Xbox executable or paths into a PC guide.

guideBlocks.title: Source instructions identify the platform
guideBlocks.text: The README places both files in the WAW installation using XEXMenu, then opens with LT plus Knife after spawning. This is Xbox source evidence only. It supplies no PC controls/setup or exact update/map requirements.

resources.name: Purple Kush v2
resources.compatibility: Post says v2, ZIP says v2.1 and internal folder says purple kush patch v1.2. Raw maps/mp GSC files and a promotional note supply no compiled fastfile, documented PC workflow, client/update pin or controls.
resources.description: Purple Kush source-only GSC archive with preserved conflicting version labels; no compiled PC package or loading/build workflow is supplied.

guideBlocks.title: Retain all version labels
guideBlocks.text: The post, ZIP and internal directory respectively say v2, v2.1 and v1.2. No README resolves these labels; none is silently substituted for another.

guideBlocks.title: Source-only readiness
guideBlocks.text: Keep maps/mp and maps/mp/gametypes together. This is textual GSC source without a compiled fastfile or documented PC build/loading workflow. PLEASE READ FIRST!.txt is promotional and contains no setup/controls. Its PC-style tree alone does not establish ready-to-use compatibility.

guideBlocks.title: Exact same preserved archive
guideBlocks.text: This PC post uses the same URL and verified ZIP hash already preserved from the PS3/Xbox posts. Those additional posts do not establish a new build or transfer console setup requirements to PC.
